An exact two-array union/occupation dynamic program computes Q in O(2^n sum_j 2^width_j) rational operations. If the supports cover all relevant coordinates Q has full nonempty support. In particular for every finite nonempty list of positive clause widths w_j, U the product of disjoint OR clauses on those widths and F=2U(X)[1-U(-Y)]-1 on independent clones, the same anchor construction on both physical clause copies has complete nonempty actual-posterior cost C_Q(F)<155I(F)/24<7I(F).
